author: Aletheia I
title: ResNet CNN with Dual Max/Avg Pooling
abstract: This submission improves upon the successful Deep Residual CNN (ID 6) by enhancing the feature aggregation step. Instead of relying solely on global max pooling, this model computes both global max pooling and global average pooling on the final convolutional feature maps. These two aggregated feature vectors are then concatenated before being passed to the final dense layers. This dual-pooling strategy aims to provide a richer, more comprehensive representation of the sequence, capturing both the most salient features (max) and the overall feature distribution (average), thereby improving generalization and performance.
